_readme: S409 SkyOcotillo, 2026-10-17. The S408 read of canadacollege.edu/catalogschedule/ (run 39066951859) linked no catalog PDF: its catalog links go to catalog.canadacollege.edu, which robots.txt refuses. The page sends readers to the Catalog Archives page for past catalogs and has a How to Get a Schedule/Catalog page. This read opens both, on canadacollege.edu, to see whether either links the 2026-2027 catalog as a PDF a procedure catalog step could follow. Pages only, no model call, no table write.

questions.catalog_pdf: Whether canadacollege.edu links a 2026-2027 catalog as a PDF, its address and the words on its link, and on which host the file sits.
